scope: eight duration-eligible windows; repaired final-mirror no-harm exporter; frontend isolation within one exact backend epoch
historical_pooling_policy: do not pool this repaired exporter epoch with either prior frontend comparison epoch
repeat_unit: VINS replay of one arm-window feature bag; export once at r1 and reuse immutable bag for r2/r3

window_policy.selection_basis: the already preregistered supplemental-v1 roster, selected from historical nonempty vio.csv before noharm-v2 outcomes

accuracy.alignment: independent fixed-scale proper SE(3) per trajectory
accuracy.common_support: one intersection over all 3 arms x 3 repeats within each window
accuracy.scientific_unit: window; repeats are not independent samples

frozen_runtime.final_mirror_noharm_contract: zero surviving sidecars restores independent KLT mirror verbatim; surviving sidecars replace equal-count KLT tracks under the 350 cap

storage.reason: storage-only offload shared by every arm; workspace filesystem had less than 4 GiB free at registration

proxy_reference_disclosure: APE/RPE measure agreement with COLMAP or dataset baseline proxy, not independent ground-truth absolute error
source_lineage_disclosure: the seedchain config matches P_legacy_nativeq_xfeat_seedchain_v3; the exporter is a newly repaired and separately hashed frontend epoch, so prior results are not relabeled
